query:
SELECT image_url AS "key!" FROM users
        WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url !~ '^https?://'
        UNION
        SELECT image_url FROM artists
        WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url !~ '^https?://'
        UNION
        SELECT image_url FROM albums
        WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url !~ '^https?://'
        UNION
        SELECT url FROM image_candidates WHERE url !~ '^https?://'
